rv.q: The roaring laughter, hoots, and whistles from the audience throughout the play, culminating in multiple curtain calls, confirmed that they were not disappointed and truly appreciated the spectacular performances they just witnessed.
Spamalot mostly succeeds at delivering barbs with bouquets.
The tour of Spamalot is dangerously overdressed at times, but it's very good at trying to please Python purists and traditional musical theater fans at the same time.
Did I still leave smiling at the show's utter silliness? Absolutely.
For individuals looking to escape and laugh a little, or to drag their grandkids to a very confusing night of musical theater, Spamalot is the perfect show for you.
